stored.description: True when the host remembered the note.

created_at.description: Host-stamped creation time, ms since epoch.

refused.description: True when the host declined the write.

reasonCode.description: The host's reason for a declined write, or the plugin's for a refused argument (TAGS_NOT_SUPPORTED_ON_HOST_ROUTE, PROJECT_NOT_SUPPORTED_ON_HOST_ROUTE, PINNED_NOT_SUPPORTED_ON_HOST_ROUTE, CONTENT_REQUIRED).

migration.description: Carried once on the first host-routed act after upgrade: the legacy KV set replayed into the host record, oldest first.
